procedure: Classify economic units and compare fit of candidate methods.
Calibrate material assumptions with alternatives and consequences.
Select coherent cash-flow, discount, terminal and ownership policies.
Reconcile methods and one claims bridge; return unavailable implementation or evidence.

acceptance.expectation: Method roles and exclusions follow economic fit, with no fixed DCF/comps pair.
Dominant assumptions include observed support, calibration, alternatives and supported conclusion strength.
Ownership policy records consolidation_policy, nci_policy, lease_policy and share_rights_policy with model paths and exceptions.
Segment controls, finance funding, associates, dilution and claims are reconciled without double counting.

conditions: Required input unavailable or hash/version stale
Acceptance is failed or not performed
failure.record: failure_records with affected record, missing evidence/test, consequence, owner, next action and interim conclusion restriction

artifact_alias_semantics: Logical plan output names for the corresponding method records, not extra completed artifacts. Preserve unit, current version and actual completion/review state; a design or formula specification is not an executed model or reconciled numerical bridge.
